import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
from agentclash_eval.refund import run_refund_case

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
SUITE = json.loads((ROOT / "suite.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("_agentclash_generated_adapter", ROOT / "adapter.py")
if _spec is None or _spec.loader is None:
    raise RuntimeError("Cannot load the generated AgentClash adapter")
_adapter = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_spec)
_spec.loader.exec_module(_adapter)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("case", SUITE["cases"], ids=lambda case: case["case_id"])
def test_refund_regression(case):
    run_refund_case(case, suite=SUITE, target=_adapter.invoke_target)

"""Load a user-selected target. There is deliberately no fake passing target.

Use only the injected tool fixture for refunds, charges, and subscriptions.

"""
import importlib
import os
import re


def invoke_target(prompt, tools):
    reference = os.environ.get("AGENTCLASH_EVAL_TARGET", "")
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.]*:[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*", reference):
        raise RuntimeError("Set AGENTCLASH_EVAL_TARGET to an importable module:callable; no default target is provided")
    module_name, callable_name = reference.split(":", 1)
    if module_name in ("adapter", "_agentclash_generated_adapter") and callable_name == "invoke_target":
        raise RuntimeError("AGENTCLASH_EVAL_TARGET must name your own agent, not this adapter")
    target = getattr(importlib.import_module(module_name), callable_name)
    if not callable(target):
        raise TypeError("AGENTCLASH_EVAL_TARGET does not resolve to a callable")
    return target(prompt, tools)
